description: Apex tests that fail on aer, the local Apex runtime, and pass in a Salesforce org. scripts/aer-run.js --gate fails on any other failure and on a test that reports no result. Categories: "runtime gap" (aer behaves differently from Salesforce, shown), "profile" (the copy has no profiles folder) and "unclassified" (the cause is not yet known).

failures.error: Passes in a Salesforce org. On aer the save is not refused when the parent is found by a key the user cannot read. First error on aer: AssertException: DML_Builder_TEST.cls:3387: Assertion Failed: Assertion failed: Expected the save to be refused; it went through with a parent found by a key the user cannot read

Passes in a Salesforce org. On aer the refusal is a DmlException about inaccessible fields, where Salesforce throws an SObjectException. First error on aer: AssertException: DML_Builder_TEST.cls:2976: Assertion Failed: The provided object is not an instance of class System.SObjectException: Expected the refusal user mode gives. Actual: System.DmlException: Operation failed due to fields being inaccessible on Sobject Foobar__c, check errors on Exception or Result!

Passes in a Salesforce org. On aer the warning does not name the parent field under Account. First error on aer: AssertException: DML_Builder_TEST.cls:3295: Assertion Failed: Expected the warning to name the field under Account: Expected: 1, Actual: 0

Passes in a Salesforce org. On aer a user-mode upsert by Id is not refused for a user without the create permission. First error on aer: AssertException: DML_Builder_TEST.cls:3646: Assertion Failed: Assertion failed: Expected user mode to refuse the upsert; it went through without the create permission

Passes in a Salesforce org. On aer the retried row fails with INSUFFICIENT_ACCESS_ON_CROSS_REFERENCE_ENTITY. First error on aer: AssertException: DML_Transaction_TEST.cls:1661: Assertion Failed: Expected the locked row to be saved by the second statement. Actual errors: (Database.Error[getFields=();getMessage=insufficient access rights on cross-reference id: a05aer000000001;getStatusCode=INSUFFICIENT_ACCESS_ON_CROSS_REFERENCE_ENTITY;])

Passes in a Salesforce org. On aer getInteger does not refuse a number with a fraction. First error on aer: AssertException: QRY_Builder_TEST.cls:7044: Assertion Failed: Assertion failed: Expected getInteger to refuse a number with a fraction

Passes in a Salesforce org. The SQL aer builds for the query has no TOLABEL. First error on aer: QRY_Engine.cls:1717: QRY_Engine.cls:1887: failed to execute SQL: SQL logic error: no such column: TOLABEL (1)

Passes in a Salesforce org. On aer the permission set group summary lacks the permission of its permission set. First error on aer: AssertException: SEL_CustomPermission_TEST.cls:808: Assertion Failed: Expected true: the group summary permission set holds the permission of the Administrator permission set

Passes in a Salesforce org. aer turns into JSON a context that Salesforce cannot. First error on aer: AssertException: UTIL_ValidationRule_TEST.cls:1086: Assertion Failed: Expected empty merge fields when the context cannot be turned into JSON: Expected: [][], Actual: [Test][]
